game_concept: A survival strategy set in Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp, a caravan camp: the oasis keeper must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Validation Fortress: Write input checks that reject bad data so vultures can't sneak through.
theme: Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp: a caravan camp
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Week 7 examination practice: Integer division: declare resource as int, apply resource / 3, and print each result with %d. Dataset 9 starts with [-3, 0, 21, 24]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Validation Fortress' (Week 9 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Caravan Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the palm grove from vultures in Caravan Camp: keep the fortress meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: fortress drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
hint: Declare before use. int resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %d.
